description.text: Start Deck 100, released on 17 December 2021: one of 100 different ready-built 60-card decks, numbered 001 to 100, in each box, so which deck a player started with was left to chance. Each came with damage counters and markers, and every deck holds an Ultra Ball. New cards in it include Kingler V and Kingler VMAX, a Zamazenta V with a new Ability, and the Supporter Marnie's Pride.
